build_resnet14_sparse_convnet: build a ResNet14 sparse convolutional network using BasicBlock with 1 layer per stage for 3D point cloud segmentation
build_resnet50_bottleneck_convnet: build a ResNet50 sparse convolutional network using Bottleneck blocks with 3-4-6-3 layers per stage for 3D segmentation
build_stresnet50_spatiotemporal_convnet: build a STResNet50 spatiotemporal sparse convolutional network using spatial hypercube temporal hypercross convolutions for 4D data
build_strestesseractnet101_convnet: build a STResTesseractNet101 fully 4D hypercube sparse convolutional network with 3-4-23-3 Bottleneck layers for spatiotemporal tasks
review_resnetbase_make_layer: review the ResNetBase _make_layer method to understand how sparse ResNet stages are constructed with downsampling and dilation
